# LegendKeeper API coverage

lk-mcp performs every one of the 89 operations of the LegendKeeper v3 API (`docs/legendkeeper/openapi.json`). For each operation: the tools that perform it, and the tool parameter that carries each request field. `TestCoverage_X_COV_01` fails the build if the spec gains an operation or field this table doesn't map.
